text: Apollo is reportedly finalizing an acquisition of nearly 10% of Mubadala Capital. The firms maintain an existing financing partnership and a $2.5 bilion private-credit joint venture. Transaction terms remain undisclosed; no announcement is confirmed.

meta.note: Pending announcement; inversion applies to the direction of equity investment, not control of the existing partnership.

text: Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to approximately 60,000 employees across four countries, covering 27% of its workforce. Eligible roles extend through vice president level. Participation is optional, with no stated reduction target. AI infrastructure spending remains elevated.

meta.note: Contraction remains conditional on employee participation; no realized workforce reduction is established.

text: Anthropic files an SEC registration for a Nasdaq IPO under ANT. Founder LLC retains 50.1% voting control. Disclosures include $16.29 billion in first-half revenue, $80.7 billion in net losses, and $417 billion in contracted computing commitments.

meta.note: Filing establishes a pending listing, not a completed public-market transition; reported losses include noncash adjustments.

text: DOJ charges Comey with unauthorized disclosure of national defense information and conspiracy. The October 5 filing is unsealed. Comey seeks dismissal on statute-of-limitations grounds. A separate indictment remains pending; an earlier indictment was dismissed.

meta.note: Charges remain allegations; procedural validity and the statute-of-limitations dispute are unresolved.
